## Summary

Describe the user-facing problem and the chosen solution.

## Verification

- [ ] `mix format --check-formatted`
- [ ] `mix test`
- [ ] `mix docs --warnings-as-errors`
- [ ] `mix hex.build`

## Compatibility and schema

- [ ] ExUnit failure and exit semantics remain unchanged.
- [ ] Async test ownership remains isolated.
- [ ] The JSON schema is unchanged, or the change is documented.
- [ ] Public documentation and changelog are updated when necessary.

## Additional context

Include screenshots or report excerpts only when they contain no sensitive
application data.
